feature_schema.name: incoming_tx_count
feature_schema.description: Total number of historical incoming transfers received up to the analysis cutoff.
feature_schema.limitations: High for legitimate merchants and payment collectors as well as fan-in mules.

feature_schema.name: outgoing_tx_count
feature_schema.description: Total number of historical outgoing transfers sent up to the analysis cutoff.
feature_schema.limitations: Payroll accounts and splitter mules both exhibit elevated outgoing counts.

feature_schema.name: incoming_volume
feature_schema.description: Aggregate monetary value of incoming transfers before the cutoff timestamp.
feature_schema.limitations: Must be contextualized against declared turnover and account segment.

feature_schema.name: outgoing_volume
feature_schema.description: Aggregate monetary value of outgoing transfers before the cutoff timestamp.
feature_schema.limitations: High volume alone does not imply illicit activity.

feature_schema.name: avg_incoming_amount
feature_schema.description: Mean monetary value per incoming transfer.
feature_schema.limitations: Sensitive to single large legitimate deposits such as property or bonus payments.

feature_schema.name: avg_outgoing_amount
feature_schema.description: Mean monetary value per outgoing transfer.
feature_schema.limitations: May appear moderate when large sums are split across many smaller transfers.

feature_schema.name: tx_amount_std
feature_schema.description: Standard deviation of transaction amounts across all account activity.
feature_schema.limitations: Zero or low for accounts with very few transactions.

feature_schema.name: tx_amount_cv
feature_schema.description: Coefficient of variation (std / mean) measuring uniformity vs dispersion of transfer sizes.
feature_schema.limitations: Fixed-amount structuring rings may show artificially low variability.

feature_schema.name: unique_counterparties
feature_schema.description: Total distinct sender and receiver accounts interacting with this account.
feature_schema.limitations: Retail businesses naturally transact with many distinct customers.

feature_schema.name: in_out_count_ratio
feature_schema.description: Ratio of incoming transaction count to outgoing transaction count.
feature_schema.limitations: High values occur in both funnel mules and merchant collection accounts.

feature_schema.name: out_in_volume_ratio
feature_schema.description: Ratio of total outgoing volume to total incoming volume.
feature_schema.limitations: Values near 0.90-1.02 indicate near-complete pass-through when paired with short holding times.

feature_schema.name: passthrough_symmetry_score
feature_schema.description: Closeness of incoming and outgoing volume to 1:1 parity (1 - |in - out| / max(in, out)).
feature_schema.limitations: Requires holding-time context to distinguish from zero-balance sweep accounts.

feature_schema.name: turnover_to_declared_ratio
feature_schema.description: Ratio of observed monthly transaction turnover to KYC declared monthly turnover.
feature_schema.limitations: Depends on accuracy of self-declared KYC onboarding figures.

feature_schema.name: burst_ratio_7d_vs_90d
feature_schema.description: Share of 90-day transaction volume concentrated in the most recent 7 days.
feature_schema.limitations: Can be elevated by legitimate seasonal or one-time personal events.

feature_schema.name: recent_vs_baseline_volume_ratio
feature_schema.description: Ratio of recent 14-day daily volume rate to prior historical daily volume rate.
feature_schema.limitations: Newly opened accounts have shorter historical baselines.

feature_schema.name: median_holding_time_hours
feature_schema.description: Estimated median elapsed hours between receiving funds and sending onward transfers.
feature_schema.limitations: Approximated from timestamp deltas between sequential inflows and outflows.

feature_schema.name: rapid_passthrough_ratio
feature_schema.description: Proportion of outgoing transfers executed within 3 hours of a preceding incoming transfer.
feature_schema.limitations: Active day-traders or instant wallet users may occasionally trigger rapid transfers.

feature_schema.name: account_age_days
feature_schema.description: Age of the account in days at the analysis cutoff timestamp.
feature_schema.limitations: Compromised or dormant-takeover mule accounts may be several years old.

feature_schema.name: dormancy_gap_days
feature_schema.description: Longest period of inactivity before renewed transaction activity.
feature_schema.limitations: Seasonal accounts naturally have long inactivity gaps.

feature_schema.name: dormancy_burst_indicator
feature_schema.description: Composite indicator of prolonged dormancy followed by high-velocity recent turnover.
feature_schema.limitations: Should be reviewed alongside account holder contact/device changes.

feature_schema.name: in_degree
feature_schema.description: Number of distinct accounts sending funds directly to this account.
feature_schema.limitations: Captures 1-hop incoming connectivity only.

feature_schema.name: out_degree
feature_schema.description: Number of distinct destination accounts receiving funds from this account.
feature_schema.limitations: Captures 1-hop outgoing connectivity only.

feature_schema.name: pagerank_score
feature_schema.description: Volume-weighted directed PageRank centrality scaled by 1,000.
feature_schema.limitations: Depends on the scope of transactions available in the monitored institution.

feature_schema.name: clustering_coefficient
feature_schema.description: Fraction of connected triangles among an account's immediate neighborhood.
feature_schema.limitations: Shared household circles and circular mule rings both increase local clustering.

feature_schema.name: cycle_participation_score
feature_schema.description: Indicator of participation in 2-hop bidirectional or short directed cycles (up to length 5).
feature_schema.limitations: Friends splitting bills back and forth can create 2-hop reciprocity.

feature_schema.name: high_risk_channel_ratio
feature_schema.description: Proportion of transfers using instant P2P, crypto ramps, or cross-border wires.
feature_schema.limitations: Modern digital banking users frequently prefer instant payment rails.

risk_scoring_methodology.title: FlyGuard AI Multi-Stage Risk Scoring & Triage Layer
risk_scoring_methodology.disclaimer: A normalized risk score is an investigative triage signal on a 0-100 index, NOT a direct percentage probability of criminal guilt. A score of 80 does NOT mean an 80% probability of money laundering. All high-risk predictions require human investigator review and corroborating evidence.

stages.description: Unadjusted logistic output probability from the XGBoost ensemble classifier.
Empirical probability calibrated on the held-out validation split via isotonic regression.
Piecewise-linear monotonic mapping of calibrated probability onto a 0-100 operational triage scale: [0.00-0.15 -> 0-35], [0.15-0.45 -> 35-65], [0.45-0.78 -> 65-85], [0.78-1.00 -> 85-100].
Configurable categorical band (Low, Moderate, High, Critical) applied to the normalized score.
Operational queue priority (None, Low, Medium, High, Urgent) for AML triage workflows.

limitations:
1. Synthetic Data Disclaimer: This model was trained and evaluated on synthetic financial transaction patterns. High test metrics on synthetic data do NOT guarantee equivalent performance on real-world banking records.
2. Decision Support Only: Risk scores and SHAP feature attributions are investigative leads, not proof of criminal conduct.
3. Legitimate High-Velocity Overlap: Small businesses, payment collection aggregators, and shared household accounts can exhibit high counterparty fan-in or rapid turnover that mimics money-mule behavior.
4. Observational Scope: Graph centrality and holding-time estimates reflect only transfers visible within the platform.
